tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Never runs dry, however much is drawn; every second it tops up machines that draw MRU through a Bound Gem within %s blocks (up to %s per pass)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 怎么拉都不减；每秒给 %s 格内靠绑定宝石吃 MRU 的机器补满（每轮至多 %s 台）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Never runs dry, however much is drawn; every second it tops up ESPE in Mithriline Furnaces, crystal pillars and the like within %s blocks (up to %s per pass)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 怎么抽都不减；每秒给 %s 格内的米斯莱熔炉、水晶柱等补满 ESPE（每轮至多 %s 个）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Right-click with an empty hand to switch. Heat: a Heat Generator loses nothing on this side. Cold: one block runs a Cold Distillator at %s cold, a full frost stone setup
tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 空手右键切换。热源：热力产能器这一面不衰减；冷源：一块就给冷凝器 %s 冷值，顶满配的霜冻石

tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Keep it on you (inventory, offhand or a ring slot): everything that costs MRU is paid from it, and it never goes down; while you carry it, Void Armor and the Computer Guy's Suit never run out of charge
tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 带在身上（背包、副手或饰品栏指环位）：所有花 MRU 的东西都从它扣，永远不减；带着它时虚空套装和宅男套装的电不会耗尽

tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.creativ.en: Keep it on you (inventory or a necklace slot): UBMRU stays full; matrix damage and Hoanna radiation stay at zero
tooltip.essentialcraft5.creative.creativ.zh: 带在身上（背包或饰品栏项链位）：UBMRU 保持满，矩阵损伤和海纳尔辐射保持为 0

message.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Infinite MRU Source: topped up %s machine(s) last pass (within %s blocks, once a second)
message.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 无尽 MRU 源：上一轮给 %s 台机器补了 MRU（%s 格内，每秒一轮）

message.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.en: Infinite ESPE Source: topped up %s block(s) last pass (within %s blocks, once a second)
message.essentialcraft5.creative.infinit.zh: 无尽 ESPE 源：上一轮给 %s 个方块补了 ESPE（%s 格内，每秒一轮）
